name: red-team

findings.message: A persisted `current_iter` larger than `_CYCLE_MAX_ITER` causes the iteration loop to execute zero times on resume, then fall through to the post-loop `unconverged` path (line 2954), so the entire cycle's work is skipped; with `on_max=continue`, downstream stages (review, pr, deploy) then run against unbuilt code.

The DSCMBR-1 member-skip path skips a cycle member marked complete without verifying its primary artifact is present after rehydration; DSRHYD-2 requires exit 1 before any stage.start when a complete stage's artifact is absent, but `stage.start` for the interrupted member at line 1497 fires even when a skipped member's artifact is gone.
findings.quote:
if [[ "$_cmbr_status" == "complete" ]]; then
                # Add persisted verdict/status to blob so exit_when/abort_when/until
                # predicates that reference this member can evaluate correctly.
                local _cmbr_verdict
                _cmbr_verdict="$(jq -r --arg s "$s" '.stage_verdicts[$s] // "pass"' \
                    "$state_file" 2>/dev/null || echo "pass")"
                local _cmbr_blob_entry _cmbr_new_blob
                _cmbr_blob_entry="$(jq -cn --arg v "$_cmbr_verdict" --arg st "$_cmbr_status" \
                    '{verdict: $v, status: $st}')"
                _cmbr_new_blob="$(jq -c --arg s "$s" --argjson e "$_cmbr_blob_entry" \
                    '. + {($s): $e}' <<< "$blob" 2>/dev/null)" \
                    && blob="$_cmbr_new_blob" \
                    || warn "cycle-orchestrator: failed to update verdict blob for skipped member '$s'; cycle predicates (exit_when/abort_when/until) may evaluate incorrectly"
                continue

reason: the red-team lens found a medium or high or critical problem the change introduced
